notes.title: Patch on 6/2/20
notes.content:
Red Planet Farming is over a week old now, and we are so humbled by the number of reviews, kind words, comments, criticism, and feedback that we have received. I also want to thank everyone that has found a bug and reported it. I've just released a patch that addresses a lot of the issues that have been brought up in the past week:

[list]
[*]Added Mute Button
[*]Fix sometimes-vanishing buttons on the region select screen
[*]Fix issue with buildings & upgrades reappearing after restarting a level
[*]Fix small upgrade adjacency bonus bug
[*]ABILITY TO DESELECT ITEMS! (click esc while holding a seed/upgrade/building!)
[*]Fix nitrogen plant sometimes showing incorrect $ estimate
[*]Infinite play button bug (you can no longer repeatedly click the play button for infinite food production)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch on 5/26/20
notes.content:
First patch is up for Red Planet Farming. There will be a more extensive patch coming soon, but there were a few things that I wanted to address immediately:
[list]
[*]Removed the button on the title screen that didn't do anything
[*]Fixed the issue many players were having where the "Accept" button on the results screen wasn't working at Medusae Fossae
[*]Typo fixes
[/list]

This is our first launch and we are so grateful for everyone’s feedback and support. Thank you for your patience while we work on fixing bugs!
